Fixing it means changing `ledger/money.py`, not anything under `generated/`.

I haven't changed any code. Want me to fix it? Halves are exact in decimal, so the cleanest fix is `decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

Separately, the suite prints about 1,500 DEBUG lines from `ledger.sync`, including rows skipped for an unknown account `legacy-card`. It isn't a failure, but it makes the output hard to read.

I also saved your rule about not editing `generated/` to memory so it carries over to later sessions.
